Start from each `Treatments` record; combine it with each `Dogs` record for which dog id (`Dogs.dog_id`) equals dog id (`Treatments.dog_id`), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); combine it with each `Breeds` record for which breed code (`Breeds.breed_code`) equals breed code (`Dogs.breed_code`) (compared as text, character by character), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); group the kept records by dog id (`Treatments.dog_id`) and breed name (`Breeds.breed_name`); each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) dog id (`Treatments.dog_id`); (2) breed name (`Breeds.breed_name`); (3) the sum of cost of treatment (`Treatments.cost_of_treatment`) in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 2. Start from the rows of step 1; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the sum of column (3) of step 1 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 3. Start from the rows of step 1; combine it with the rows of step 2 for which it is not true that column (1) of step 2 is missing, one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 1; (2) column (2) of step 1; (3) column (3) of step 1; (4) A ÷ B. Here A is column (3) of step 1; B is column (1) of step 2.
Step 4. Start from the rows of step 3; group the kept records by column (2) of step 3; each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) column (2) of step 3; (2) the sum of column (3) of step 3 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (3) the average of column (4) of step 3 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 5. Start from the rows of step 4; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the average of column (3) of step 4 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 6. Start from the rows of step 4; combine it with the rows of step 5 for which it is not true that column (1) of step 5 is missing, one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); keep only the records for which column (3) of step 4 is greater than column (1) of step 5; for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 4; (2) column (2) of step 4; (3) column (3) of step 4; (4) A − B. Here A is column (3) of step 4; B is column (1) of step 5.
Step 7 (the answer). Start from the rows of step 6; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the sum of column (2) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (2) the average of column (3) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (3) the average of column (4) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).

examples.construction: agg:Dogs within Breeds.breed_name > share:all > agg:g > baseline:all > agg:all
why: total of cost of treatment per Dogs within Breeds.breed_name (additive)
share of the all total of total of cost of treatment (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
gap to the all average of average of total of cost of treatment: share of the all total (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
examples.sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Treatments"."dog_id" AS e, "Breeds"."breed_name" AS g, SUM("Treatments"."cost_of_treatment") AS m1 FROM "Treatments" JOIN "Dogs" ON "Dogs"."dog_id" = "Treatments"."dog_id" JOIN "Breeds" ON "Breeds"."breed_code" = "Dogs"."breed_code" GROUP BY "Treatments"."dog_id", "Breeds"."breed_name"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m2") AS v FROM "s4"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, ("s4"."m2" - "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s4"."m2" > "s5"."v") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
